subject: Re: iALS kickoff - resourcing + Corpus migration timing
body:
Dmitri,

Resourcing, short version because this really is a small footprint:

- Staffing: Bilal 50%, Linnea 40%, Rosa 30%, Oyin 20%.
- Compute: CPU-dominant; a handful of titan-a100 GPUs best-effort for the sweep weeks. Nothing to reserve.
- Data: the NCF benchmark datasets (MovieLens 1M, Pinterest) are getting registered on Corpus so Evalline can consume the baseline reproducibly. Planning note: the Corpus v2 migration freeze is 2026-06-26, so Rosa will register everything as v2-native from the start - our project closes in April, but I don't want the packaged baseline to be one of those things that breaks in late June because it pointed at v1 paths.

One genuine annoyance: the upstream NCF evaluation code needs a Python 2.7 runtime. Oyin is isolating it in a container; if security pushes back on py2.7 we may need Bilal to port the eval loop instead, which would cost ~2 weeks.

Deshawn
